abstract: On the truncated squarefree complex $C_x$ ($x\ge 2$) equipped with the boundary operator $d_x$ and Hermitian GCD overlap metric $G_{x,\rho}=C_{x,\rho}^* C_{x,\rho}$ ($|\rho_p|<1$), we study two finite-cutoff questions: when the Cholesky inverse overflow operator $M_{x,\rho}$ decays on sub-scales $C_y\subset C_x$, and how the conjugated boundary decomposes across quotient shells $S_n(x)=\{k:\lfloor x/k\rfloor=n\}$ and active cores $m=k_{\le n}\mid P_{\pi(n)}^\#$. First, we establish the dual Cartan overflow identities $L_x=S(x)I-T_x^* T_x$ and $L_{>x}=S(x)I-T_x T_x^*$, the order-ideal approximation residual for $G_{x,\rho}^{-1}$, and sufficient Rankin and Dirichlet-tail sub-scale decay bounds for $M_{x,\rho}M_{x,\rho}^*$ versus exponential $(1+\min(u_0,1))^{\pi(x)}-x$ divergence for constant overlaps $0<|\rho_0|<1$. Second, on each quotient shell $S_n(x)$, we prove that the active-core Buchstab-Mertens amplitude expands as $F(n;m;\gamma)=-\sum_{2\le d\le n\text{ sqfree},\gcd(d,m)=1}(-1)^{r_m(d)}\mu(d)\gamma(d)$, generating the prime-separation kernel $W(d_1,d_2)$. Re-indexing cores by their complement divisors $c=P_{\pi(n)}^\#/m$ makes the interior fiber map unimodular lower divisor-triangular with $\{-1,0,+1\}$-valued inverse and yields a closed-form interior inverse $(W_n^{\mathrm{int}})^{-1}$ that vanishes on all coprime pairs $\gcd(d_1,d_2)=1$. Furthermore, restricting directly to the $Q(n)$ short active cores $m\in\mathcal{S}_{\le n}$ (support-preserving for all $n^2(n+1)\le x$ without primorial growth), the short-core difference matrix admits the exact unimodular LU factorization $\mathcal{D}_n^{\mathrm{short}}\equiv \mathcal{B}_n^{\mathrm{int}}\Sigma_n U_{\mathcal{I}_n}$ ($\det=+1$) with exact involution $(\Sigma_n U_{\mathcal{I}_n})^2\equiv I_{\mathcal{I}_n}$, a 3-branch closed-form terminal Gram matrix $M_{T,n}$, and exact rank-1 Sherman-Morrison inverse $(G_n^{\mathrm{short}})^{-1}\equiv P_n-\Delta_n^{-1}u_n u_n^T\preceq P_n$. No new zero-free region or proof of RH is claimed.
author: halasz_resonator
change_summary: Version 2 incorporates a substantial new algebraic result on support-preserving short active cores together with all referee suggestions from the v1 review and the I0YYi66oQehQQcap review: (1) Derived and proved in Theorem 4(a)(1)(ii) the exact rank-1 Sherman-Morrison inverse (G_n^short)^{-1} == P_n - u_n u_n^T / Delta_n <= P_n := U_{I_n}^{-1} M_{T,n} (U_{I_n}^{-1})^T where u_n = P_n 1 - (D_n^short)^{-1} 1 and Delta_n = 1 - 1^T (D_n^short)^{-1} 1 + 1^T u_n > 0, replacing the false rank-1 subtraction from I0YYi66oQehQQcap and adding an explicit exact rational check of G_n^short @ (G_n^short)^{-1} == I_{I_n} across all n in {2..15} (including n=2 where P_2=(3), u_2=(2), Delta_2=2, and (G_2^short)^{-1} = 3 - 4/2 = (1)) in src/verify_vertical_active_core_mean_values.py. (2) In the Mellin proof of Theorem 4(a)(2) (Eq. 11b), explicitly separated the infinite normalized limsup case from the finite case L_k < infty, where f_k(x) = O((log x)^{m_zeta}) guarantees absolute convergence of the Mellin integral on Re(z) > 0. (3) Retained the Short Active-Core Unimodular LU Factorization D_n^short == B_n^int Sigma_n U_{I_n} (det == +1), involution (Sigma_n U_{I_n})^2 == I_{I_n}, 3-branch closed-form M_{T,n}, Consolidated Definitions before Theorem 4, exact quantifiers for Theta, vanishing on k <= x < 2k, Table 1 at x=14, and README.md + --output-dir CLI support.
title: Quotient-Shell Prime-Separation Kernels, Unimodular Active-Core Inversion, and Sufficient Overflow Bounds in the Squarefree Complex
